matched_source_facts.Option_failures: option.rs:2235 unwrap_failed and2244 expect_failed call the genuine panic/panic_display routes.
matched_source_facts.Result_and_i32_format: result.rs:1866 unwrap_failed(&str,&dyn fmt::Debug) invokes panic with Debug formatting. Real Result<_,i32>::expect sites therefore retain the i32 Debug vtable; fmt/num.rs Debug dispatch pulls Display/LowerHex/UpperHex.
matched_source_facts.bounds: Two actual checked-index edges remain: maps.rs:273 HardwareLeases::capture_locked and thread_counters.rs:230 CounterSlot::abort_new_extra. Compiler-generated panic_bounds_check is a real safety provider, not an optional diagnostic.
matched_source_facts.panic_abort: Existing panic=abort forbids unwinding; it does not inline or define every core panic/unwrap/fmt body. Matched source marks these bodies cold/noinline under this strategy.
matched_source_facts.immediate_abort_not_a_drop_in: Matched panicking.rs:35-40 explicitly rejects the old panic_immediate_abort feature and says immediate-abort requires rebuilding core. Changing the panic strategy would also bypass the existing kernel PanicInfo terminal path and is not the recommended bounded repair.

Typecheck and the HOST runtime use different final-link closures; their PASS does not supply these image definitions.

Otherwise produce a kernel-profile core closure from this same actual Rust1.95 source/compiler with the applicable large/static/no-redzone/no-SSE/panic-abort settings. Bind the real compiler-builtins and memory helper dependencies the selected objects actually need; do not guess them.

Compile mckernel_rust against that exact core metadata (and any matching companion crates). Rebuilding core with a different crate disambiguator while leaving the previous Rust object unchanged cannot correctly supply its symbol identities.

Consume the real compiler-owned closure in the normal image link. A rustc-produced static archive using the qualified kernel core/sysroot is one valid integration shape; alternatively retain object output plus its exact compatible core archive/dependency closure. The concrete recipe belongs to the separately reviewed repair packet. Keep bare image entry/linker/physical image contract and no HOST CRT/libstd.
Allow genuine core panic paths to construct PanicInfo and reach the existing handler. Do not add a second handler or manually export guessed mangled core symbols.
